messages: marta_cs: Hey team — kicking off Keystone onboarding. Goal is to align stakeholders, define success criteria, and lock the 30/60/90 timeline. Customer wants a 6-week pilot. Meeting invite sent for tomorrow 10am PT: https://calendar.example.com/keystone-kickoff :calendar:
marta_cs: Quick context — Keystone is evaluating our Dedicated offering for a fraud-detection assistant. They care about latency, cost per inference, and deterministic rollbacks.
jon_sre: tagging eng for capacity planning. Can someone confirm expected peak QPS and typical sequence length? I can model GPU pool sizing once we have that.

sam_se: I'll run enablement and onboarding workshops. Proposed plan: week1 integration + API keys, week2 model tuning + evals, week3 smoke to staging, week4 prod ramp. Will prepare runbook and recording.
alex_pm: Draft success criteria from product side:

alex_pm: - Latency (99th) <= 300ms for standard routes
- Error rate < 0.5%
- Cost per 1k requests under target (TBD with finance)
- End-to-end inference accuracy within 3% of evaluation baseline

marta_cs: Renewal risk note — procurement timeline is long with Keystone (legal + SOC audit). Marking as medium risk for renewal if onboarding drags past pilot end. Action: CS + Sales to sync on contract timeline.

jon_sre: For capacity I'll assume 200 concurrent requests and avg seq=512 tokens. If anyone has real numbers pls drop them here. Also need to know if they will use streaming or non-streaming endpoints.
sam_se: They want streaming for live scoring. I'll capture that in the workshop agenda. Also planning two 90min hands-on sessions (engineering + security).
marta_cs: Customer leads: Priya (Keystone PM) and Ben (Keystone Infra). Priya prefers weekly 30min syncs during pilot. I'll send a proposed cadence after tomorrow's kickoff.

alex_pm: Action items:
- jon_sre: run capacity calc + list config needs (due EOD Fri)
- sam_se: draft workshop agenda + runbook (due Mon)
- marta_cs: confirm customer cadence and procurement milestone (due Tue)
- alex_pm: finalize success metrics and share eval prompts (due Mon)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept.
jon_sre: Accepted :thumbsup: I'll post the sizing doc into the shared drive and ping here when done.
deploybot: Reminder: onboarding kickoff meeting scheduled for 2026-03-24 10:00 PT. Join: https://meet.example.com/keystone-kickoff
marta_cs: Thanks all. Ill capture notes and upload the kickoff recap + decision log after the call. Anything else to add before the meeting?
